thread:
jess-marketing: Quick sync: Delta blog (benchmarks + launch blurb) is queued for publish at 14:00 PDT. Two small asks before we go live: 1) confirm the per-token cost numbers on the hero chart; 2) legal ok on the competitor comparison line.

harry-eng: I spot-checked the CSVs. The hero per-token numbers are from the quantized runs with token cache enabled; that matches the doc, but the chart label currently says "unquantized". Will push a corrected SVG in 10m.

rachel-pr: Legal flagged the competitor compare phrasing as likely to trigger a follow-up. Suggested tweak: change "beats X by 2x" to "observed ~2x lower cost vs X in our long-context benchmark; see methodology." Does that work?

zoe-ops: bench-bot shows publish job 100201 at 21:00 UTC (14:00 PDT). I can pause if you want an extra window.

jess-marketing: Please pause for 15m while we confirm assets. Also, can someone add a one-line exec quote for the announcement? Ideally something short from CEO about production readiness.

harry-eng: SVG updated: fixed label to "quantized w/ cache" and uploaded to PR assets. Also added a note in the PR body about run flags.

editorial-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/content/pull/1513 has changes and new assets. Status: awaiting publish hold.

rachel-pr: Legal ok with the softer competitor language. I'll add the approved wording to the PR. For exec quote, I have a short draft for CEO: "This release brings enterprise-grade long-context inference to production workloads." Want to run it by Lydia?

jess-marketing: Yes please, slip it into the PR as "CEO quote (proposed)" and ping Lydia. If she signs, we'll include it in the front page blurb.

zoe-ops: Publish job paused. New window reserved for 14:30 PDT (21:30 UTC) to allow final signoffs.

harry-eng: Minor note: one of the methodology links pointed to an intermediate S3 path. Replaced with the canonical docs link and pushed.

editorial-bot: Reminder: scheduled social posts queued. Draft tweet copy references the headline number; will hold post until PR merges.

rachel-pr: Lydia approved the CEO quote with a tiny wording change: added "scalable" -> "enterprise-grade, scalable". Quote in PR updated.

jess-marketing: Great — final checklist: 1) assets correct (yes), 2) legal ok (yes), 3) exec quote approved (yes). Nina/PR to send embargo note?

rachel-pr: Sending embargo note now to reporters list: "Redwood Inference will publish a benchmark & launch post at 14:30 PDT; embargo lifted at publish. Contact me for questions."

zoe-ops: Publish job manually scheduled for 21:30 UTC by @jess-marketing. Social queue unlocked post-merge.

harry-eng: Leaving a final one-liner in PR: "Numbers final; runs use quantized kernels + token cache; CSV checksum: sha256:ab9f..."

jess-marketing: Thanks team. Going to merge at :00 for a 14:30 PDT push assuming no last-minute flags. If anyone sees anything, call it out here immediately. :rocket:
